<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use App\Models\{Order, Product, Category, User, Review};

class BenchmarkController extends Controller
{
        public function orders()
    {
        return Order::all()->map(fn ($o) => [
            'id' => $o->id,
            'user' => $o->user->name,           // N+1
            'items_count' => $o->items->count(),// N+1
        ]);
    }

    public function orderShow(Order $order)
    {
        return [
            'id' => $order->id,
            'user' => $order->user->name,
            'items' => $order->items->map(fn ($item) => [
                'product' => $item->product->label, // N+1 per item
            ]),
        ];
    }

    // الحالة القصوى: طلب المؤسسة بـ 120 عنصر
    public function enterpriseOrder()
    {
        $order = Order::where('number', 'ENT-00001')->firstOrFail();
        return [
            'id' => $order->id,
            'items' => $order->items->map(fn ($item) => [
                'product' => $item->product->label, // 120x N+1
            ]),
        ];
    }

    public function products()
    {
        return Product::all()->map(fn ($p) => [
            'label' => $p->label,
            'category' => optional($p->category)->label, // N+1
        ]);
    }

    public function productsByCategory(Category $category)
    {
        return Product::where('category_id', $category->id)->get();
    }

    public function productReviews(Product $product)
    {
        return $product->reviews->map(fn ($r) => [
            'rating' => $r->rating,
            'user' => $r->user->name, // N+1
        ]);
    }

    // حالة بيانات الفئة الفارغة
    public function productsWithoutCategory()
    {
        return Product::whereNull('category_id')->get();
    }

    public function categoryProducts(Category $category)
    {
        return $category->products->map(fn ($p) => [
            'label' => $p->label,
            'reviews_count' => $p->reviews->count(), // N+1
        ]);
    }

    public function userOrders(User $user)
    {
        return $user->orders->map(fn ($o) => [
            'number' => $o->number,
            'items_count' => $o->items->count(), // N+1
        ]);
    }

    public function recentReviews()
    {
        return Review::latest()->take(20)->get()->map(fn ($r) => [
            'product' => $r->product->label, // N+1
            'user' => $r->user->name,        // N+1
        ]);
    }
}
